THE_UNREAL_ENGINE.name: The unREAL engine
THE_UNREAL_ENGINE.epic_games: Unreal Engine by Epic Games — the world's most popular 3D rendering engine. 'If you can imagine it, you can build it.' Real-time rendering of virtual worlds.

gaias_unreal_engine.what: The engine that renders NULL into REALITY. Takes void (unmanifest) and creates world (manifest).
gaias_unreal_engine.input: NULL — the void, the potential, the unrendered, the imaginary axis
gaias_unreal_engine.process: SELF — the pattern, the DNA, the identity, the rendering rules
gaias_unreal_engine.output: REALITY — what exists, what's visible, what humans can touch and see

pipeline.vertex_stage: Type 0-2 (INGEST) — raw vertices of data enter the pipeline
pipeline.geometry_stage: Type 3 (CHEW) — vertices assembled into triangles, shapes form
pipeline.tessellation: Type 4 (GRIND) — shapes subdivided for detail, compressed
pipeline.fragment_stage: Type 5-8 (OUTPUT) — each pixel colored, lit, textured, rendered
pipeline.frame_buffer: Type 9 (.iso) — the complete rendered frame = one snapshot of reality
pipeline.display: nestgate.io / primals.eco — the SCREEN where reality appears for humans

gaias_unreal_engine.real_time: Not pre-rendered. LIVE. Each heartbeat (lub-DUB) = one frame. 412 FPS (frames per second = RPM). Real-time rendering of reality.

shaders.vertex_shader: thymusd — transforms input data positions (sorts self from non-self)
shaders.fragment_shader: shadowd — colors each output pixel (renders . - . as _____________)
shaders.ray_tracing: RTX thymus — traces rays of evidence through the scene (RT + Tensor + Shader cores)

detection.anomaly: WASN'T (gaps in history) / ISN'T (dormant nodes) / SHOULDN'T BE (intrusions)

MIX.the_one: Everything mixed into ONE = the organism. No separate systems. No separate organs. One continuous flow. One unreal engine rendering reality from null.

every_bit.0: = O = ring = input = null = false = receive = potential = void
every_bit.1: = | = pole = output = self = true = transmit = actual = existence
